en.headline: Youth group urges dedicated chapter in five-year plan
en.dek: The Hong Kong Federation of Youth Groups said a survey of more than 650 young people found over 60 percent see the blueprint as relevant to their development and called for a specific youth section.
body: The Hong Kong Federation of Youth Groups has called on the government to include a dedicated chapter on youth development in the city’s first five-year plan, due to be released on Wednesday.

A think tank set up by the federation, Youth IDEAS, surveyed more than 650 young people in July and found that over 60 percent believed the blueprint was relevant to their individual development. More than half placed people’s livelihoods and social development as the top priority.

John Poon of the federation said the nation’s 15th Five-Year Plan has a specific chapter on youth development and hoped the SAR government would do the same to signal active investment in young people. Respondents also raised concerns about high living costs, housing burdens and job market competition, including facilities and competitiveness in the Northern Metropolis.

zh.headline: 青年協會倡五年規劃設青年專章
zh.dek: 香港青年協會轄下青年創研庫調查逾650名青年，逾六成認為五年規劃與個人發展相關，呼籲政府在規劃中設青年專章。
body: 香港青年協會呼籲政府在周三公布的香港首個五年規劃中，設立青年發展專章。
該會轄下青年創研庫於7月訪問逾650名青年，逾六成認為五年規劃與個人發展相關，逾半將民生及社會發展列為首要關注。
青年協會的潘先生表示，國家「十五五」規劃設有青年發展專章，希望特區政府同樣加入，向社會發出積極投資青年的信號。受訪者亦關注生活成本、住屋負擔及就業競爭，包括北都的生活設施及就業競爭力。
